# SundAI
Less manual work. More room to grow. AI workflows, assistants and cyber services built around your business—with control designed in.

## Services
- [Compliance, GRC & AI Governance](https://sundaibot.com/services/compliance-ai-governance/): Turn regulatory complexity into a clear plan—with risks, owners and evidence your team can actually use.
- [Secure AI Business Automation](https://sundaibot.com/services/secure-ai-automation/): Turn repetitive tasks into secure workflows built around your product, your people and the systems you already use.
- [Private AI Assistants, Agents & RAG](https://sundaibot.com/services/private-ai-agents-rag/): Custom assistants and agents connected to your knowledge—with permission-aware retrieval, scoped tools and auditable actions.
- [OSINT, Pentesting & Red Teaming](https://sundaibot.com/services/pentesting-red-teaming/): Test the attack paths that matter—and leave with findings your team can fix.
- [DevSecOps & Secure Delivery Pipelines](https://sundaibot.com/services/devsecops/): Build security into the path from commit to deployment—with controlled identities, automated checks and releases you can trace.
- [Cloud Security Engineering, Automation & Maintenance](https://sundaibot.com/services/cloud-security/): Get control of identities, privileged access, cloud configuration and security signals—then keep that foundation maintained.

- [Tailored proposals](https://sundaibot.com/pricing/): Scope-based proposals for the company, team and product; no public numeric service prices.
